implemented_behavior.xml_namespaces: NuGet accepts empty or legacy MSBuild root namespace; Maven accepts empty or standard Maven POM root namespace. Every relevant consumed element must match its accepted root namespace. A relevant foreign lookalike rejects only its artifact with one bounded audit and no fact; independent artifacts continue.
implemented_behavior.committed_inventory: One exact committed HEAD tree is streamed incrementally. Only the six supported artifact shapes are retained with exact blob object ID and mode. Output is bounded to 16 MiB, 100,000 input records, 1,000 retained supported artifacts, a bounded record buffer, 30 seconds, bounded stderr, and caller cancellation.
implemented_behavior.failure_atomicity: Inventory bound exhaustion fails the Repository detector closed before artifact parsing can retain framework facts.
